name: Reries
subtitle: BootlegYouki's apps
description: Every app here keeps its data on your phone: no account, no cloud sync.

apps.name: Setsu
apps.subtitle: Personal finance tracker
apps.localizedDescription: Track budgets, expenses, goals and debts. Everything stays on your iPhone, with backups you can export and restore.

versions.localizedDescription: Import Backup works in copies installed with KSign: picking the backup file now opens it instead of doing nothing.
Backup import works again: after you pick a backup file, the confirmation now appears instead of being lost, and it is a standard alert with Cancel and Replace.
The balance card is now a Liquid Glass card stack: your other budgets peek out behind it, and tapping sends the front card to the back.
iOS 26 design with the Liquid Glass tab bar, backup export and restore in Settings, the bamboo app icon, and Analytics and Calendar as native lists.
First release of Setsu for iPhone.

apps.name: Tabi
apps.subtitle: Applicant manager for overseas deployment
apps.localizedDescription: Track applicants going abroad: requirements, appearance reminders, cash advances, sub-agents and work expenses, plus open DFA passport appointment dates. Everything stays on your iPhone, with backups you can export and restore.

versions.localizedDescription: First release of Tabi: applicants and their requirements, appearance reminders, cash advances in pesos or dollars, sub-agents, work expenses, a printable report, and open DFA passport appointment dates per site.
